Employee Record System using Random Access & Object Serialization

Problem Statement:
You are required to build a binary file-based Employee Record System.

The program must:

Store objects directly into a binary file

Use random access to retrieve specific records

Demonstrate object serialization

🔹 Requirements
1️⃣ Create a class Employee

Data members:

int id

char name[20]

double salary

Member functions:

void input()

void display()

2️⃣ Program Operations

The program should:

Ask user for number of employees n

Write all employee objects to a binary file (employees.dat)

Ask user for a record number r

Use random access to directly jump to that record

Display the employee details

🔹 Input Format
n
id name salary
id name salary
...
record_number

Record number starts from 1

🔹 Output Format

If record exists:

Employee Found:
ID: <id>
Name: <name>
Salary: <salary>

If invalid record:

Record not found
